policy: No changes to production data or eligibility.
Metrics count independent metric keys; opposite directions do not count twice.
Numeric witnesses run the production validator with the only permitted remaining error being the target animal missing an approved photo. No synthetic photo is supplied.
Registered cartoon support does not establish anatomical quality. Raster photos still need identity, licensing and framing review.
Witness search is bounded to 1500 substitutions per difficulty per eligible catalog animal; absence of a witness is not proof no valid board exists.
